implemented: Mapped native Map/Inventory/Character/Skill/Hotbar/Command/Exit/NPC/shop/inn/quest/upgrade/loot/trade/party/clan/chat/mouse/focus paths without adding DOM game UI.

Added deterministic pinned-source browser input lifecycle patch: focus state propagation, held keyboard/mouse clear on focus loss, input reacquire on focus gain, ALT+ENTER fullscreen from a physical user gesture.
Preserved native chat/edit movement suppression and documented the source guard.
Kept Command menu separate from GM authority; pinned source GM panel remains explicitly gated by AUTHORITY_MANAGER.
Kept provider-dependent success fail-closed; no client-side skill/item/social/NPC success simulation was added.
Documented native audio event ownership and added an integration gate that refuses audio-ready status while the WS42 single-thread audio-disable guard remains.
asset_build_needs: P2-02 must publish asset/build readiness for native UI, skill/item icons and sound assets.
P2-00 must apply client-src/p2_10/apply_browser_input_lifecycle.py to the exact pinned OpenKO source after resolving any upstream patch ordering.
P2-00 must rebuild the real C++/WASM client with Emscripten 3.1.50 and publish JS/WASM/data as one provenance-matched set.
Browser audio requires an audio-capable build; the WS42 single-thread guard that returns false from CN3SndMgr::InitOpenAL cannot remain if audio is claimed working.
Do not copy or republish the previous C5 binary after these source changes.

tests_and_evidence.static_contract_tests: tests/client/test_p2_10_contracts.py added; covers required control inventory, provider fail-closed policy, Command-vs-GM separation, focus/fullscreen patch invariants and native-audio/no-DOM policy.
source_evidence: Pinned GameProcMain owns CUIInventory, CUIVarious, CUISkillTreeDlg, CUIHotKeyDlg, CUITransactionDlg, CUIWareHouseDlg, CUIInn, CUIQuestMenu/Talk, CUIItemUpgrade, CUIPartyOrForce and related native response handlers.
Pinned ProcessUIKeyInput dispatches KM_TOGGLE_INVENTORY/STATE/SKILL/CMDLIST/MINIMAP to native handlers.
Pinned movement input is gated by !IsUIKeyOperated() and no focused CN3UIEdit, so chat typing does not intentionally drive world movement.
Pinned BGM path creates native stream objects and PlayBGM_Town/PlayBGM_Battle; ReleaseSound tears them down.
tests_and_evidence.runtime_evidence: Not claimed. No direct deploy was performed and this workstream did not receive a fresh P2-00 WASM/data build to exercise at play.oldkoweb.com. runtime-evidence.json marks the exact post-integration browser cases PASS/BLOCKED without fabricating proof.
tests_and_evidence.integration_gate: client-src/p2_10/verify_browser_source.py must pass before browser smoke; it intentionally BLOCKS if the old browser-audio-disable guard is still present.

P2-10 source changes require a fresh integrated C++/WASM build and real-browser smoke. No direct publication was performed.
